description: What a workflow (a BPMN file of a solution) may contain. A workflow is plain BPMN plus the blocks of blocks.json, and nothing else can be attached to it. The core refuses to publish a workflow that breaks a rule marked refused, and warns about one marked warned.

rules: Exactly one process in the file, its id the case type's processKey, isExecutable="true"
Every step but the start, a boundary event and an event sub-process has something leading to it

elements.serviceTask: Only a block: flowable:delegateExpression set to a block's expression (blocks.json), with the block's fields as flowable:field. No flowable:class, no other delegate expression, no flowable:type.
elements.receiveTask: Only with the waitForEvent block, as an execution listener on start and on end
elements.userTask: Only an approval: flowable:category="approval"; other user tasks are never shown to anybody (warned). No task listeners.
elements.scriptTask: Only an expression: scriptFormat="juel", such as setting a variable
refused: service tasks that are not a block
a block without its required fields
an agent that does not exist
warned: a step that calls a connection or an agent without flowable:async="true"
a user task operators will never be shown

fieldValues.rule: A field of kind expression, or any value with ${...}, is written as an expression; everything else as a string. A group field (arg, input, in) is one field per part, named <group>.<part>.

atStart.subjectType: what the case is about, in a word
atStart.subjectId: the id of what it is about
atStart.eventType: the type of the event that opened it

setByTheWorkflow.outcome: how the case ended; otherwise it closes as RESOLVED
setByTheWorkflow.revenue: money the case brought in, an amount

variables.rule: A block that keeps a result keeps it under resultVariable (its default is in its description). A value is only there after the step that keeps it has run: a later step names it, an earlier one cannot.

valueNames.description: In texts, goals and the places of a text a value is named by where it comes from

names.connector.<connection>.<entity>.<detail>: what a read of a connection gave
names.options.<key>: the way chosen for the workflow
names.workflow.<name>: what a step worked out (a variable of the case)

expressionHelpers.gives: earlier cases about the same subject: what opened them and what an agent decided
what remember kept about the subject
how far the files of the case were read
a moment, such as for a timer
a date or a number written out

attributes.byHandMinutes: on a step or the process: how long a person takes to do this by hand
attributes.byHandRole: whose work it is, a key of the price list's roles
attributes.brings: on a step: the money it brings in, an amount or an expression giving one

worth.rule: Set byHandMinutes and byHandRole on every step that does a person's work, so that what the workflow saves is counted

commands: A step that calls a command goes through the workflow's policy: it may go out, wait for a person, or be refused. A new workflow starts in Test run (shadow), which records what it would do and sends nothing.
